zones.description: List of time zones to display. Each entry defines a TZ identifier and optional human-friendly name string. If name is omitted, only TZ is written per line (tzwatch-compatible format).TZ identifiers must be valid paths under /usr/share/zoneinfo/zone.tab (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York). The list is typically stored in $HOME/.tzlist or a custom file via -f option.
